title: success confirms what not bounce home
rule: Success is not “form sent” or a bounce to home — visible confirmation of what went through (repeat in mail or “Mijn omgeving”). Dual-cite empty/failure success copy; NL names bounce-home as fail.
pass_when: After send, the person sees what was submitted (on-page and/or in mail / “Mijn omgeving”), not only “sent”.
fail_when: Success is only “form sent”, or the person is bounced to home with no confirmation of what went through.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Next organisational steps as this “what went through” row; empty/failure success-copy as a merge that drops bounce-home.
